# Hiking South Africa

> Community-powered hiking platform offering comprehensive trail guides, regional hiking resources, and gear reviews across South Africa and neighboring countries.

Hiking South Africa is a dedicated resource for hikers of all levels, featuring filterable trail directories organized by region, difficulty, and hiking style. The platform serves as a central hub for discovering and planning hiking adventures throughout South Africa, Namibia, and Swaziland.

## Key Topics

- South Africa hiking
- Trail guides
- Day hikes
- Multi-day hikes
- Drakensberg
- Western Cape
- Gauteng
- Coastal trails
- Hutted trails
- Slackpacking
- Eastern Cape
- Mpumalanga
- KwaZulu-Natal
- Garden Route
- Hermanus Hop

## Core Platform

- [Hiking South Africa](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za): Community-powered hiking platform with trail guides, gear reviews, and forums
- [Trails Directory](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails): Main trail directory with filterable guides across South African regions

## Regional Trail Guides

- [Eastern Cape Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/eastern-cape): Eastern Cape hiking guides including Tsitsikamma Trail and Wild Coast Hike
- [Gauteng Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/gauteng): Gauteng trails including Rustig Trail and Magaliesberg hiking guides
- [KwaZulu-Natal Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/kwazulu-natal): KwaZulu-Natal Drakensberg hiking guides with hutted and mountain pass trails
- [Mpumalanga Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/mpumalanga): Mpumalanga hiking guides including High Five and Kaapschehoop trails
- [Western Cape Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/western-cape): Western Cape coastal trails including Hermanus Hop and Garden Route hikes
- [Free State Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/free-state): Free State trail guides with day and multi-day hiking options
- [Limpopo Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/limpopo): Limpopo trails featuring Magoebaskloof and Kruger National Park hikes

## Hiking Style & Duration

- [Day Hikes](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/day-hikes): Day hiking guides across South Africa with scenic mountain trails
- [2-3 Day Hikes](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/2-3-days): 2-3 day multi-day hiking guides including Hermanus Hop and Kaapschehoop
- [4-5 Day Hikes](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/4-5-days): 4-5 day hiking guides featuring High Five Trail and Magoebaskloof hikes
- [Hutted Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/hutted): Hutted trail guides with accommodation options across South Africa
- [Slackpacking Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/slackpacking): Slackpacking guides for lightweight hiking including coastal wilderness trails

## International & Regional Destinations

- [Namibia Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/namibia): Namibia hiking guides featuring Fish River Canyon trail and desert hikes
- [Swaziland Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/swaziland): Swaziland hiking guides including Malolotja Nature Reserve trail

## Optional & Specialty Guides

- [North West Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/north-west): North West region trails with Magaliesberg Mountains hiking guides
- [Northern Cape Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/northern-cape): Northern Cape desert and coastal hiking guides including Namaqualand
- [Dog-Friendly Trails](https://hikingsouthafrica.co.za/blogs/trails/tagged/dog-friendly): Pet-friendly hiking guides for dog owners across South African regions
